Description

The W22 Severe Process motor operates at 400 V, 50 Hz with IE3 efficiency class. Rated power ranges from 0.75 kW to 15 kW. Full load current at 1.1 kW is 7.22 A. Speed at full load: 1455 rpm. Motor weight: 19.5 kg. IP56 protection rating.
